nodes.name: README_API.md
nodes.summary: Developer setup and API reference guide for the SmartLAB Django backend, covering virtualenv setup, PostgreSQL/PostGIS configuration (Docker and local options), GeoDjango GDAL/GEOS installation on Windows, JWT authentication endpoints, main REST API routes, and technical architecture notes.

nodes.name: render.yaml
nodes.summary: Render.com deployment configuration defining the labconnect-api Python web service with build commands (pip install, collectstatic, migrate), gunicorn start command, and environment variables including Supabase PostgreSQL URL and production Django settings.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Render's blueprint format; DATABASE_URL points to a Supabase-hosted PostgreSQL instance, and SECRET_KEY is auto-generated by Render on first deploy.

nodes.name: requirements.txt
nodes.summary: Python dependency manifest for the SmartLAB backend, specifying pinned versions for Django 5, DRF with JWT and OpenAPI, PostgreSQL/psycopg2, TOTP/QR codes, PDF generation via reportlab, Django Channels and Celery for async tasks, MinIO for object storage, and gunicorn/whitenoise for production serving.
nodes.languageNotes: The file contains two duplicate loose entries (pyotp, qrcode) at the end without version pins, which are already pinned earlier in the file — these are likely leftover from a merge and should be removed.
